title: 小床接住你
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE original full-bleed vertical 9:16 watercolor story illustration for one locked narration shot. Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve the existing named identities, not just their species. Input 1: identity for 皮皮 (pipi), preserve exactly: 暖灰毛、圆脸、粉色小鼻、自然下垂长耳；身份不随活动和换装变化。 Input 2: clothing only for 皮皮: 换装表右：原深蓝星星睡帽和黄色帽球，保留原兔体型；玩偶和毛毯是另行配置的场景道具。 Input 3: environment layout / watercolor style ONLY. Keep the geography and furnishings, but draw ONLY the requested people and props for this shot, never copy unwanted actors. This is not an image to reuse as the output.
Visible characters: 皮皮 (pipi). Exact total number of visible characters: 1. Do not draw extra background animals. Standing body-height ratios (not ear or tail tips): 皮皮 1.0. Pipi wears ONLY the RIGHT bedtime star cap, navy with pale yellow stars and yellow pompom. No overalls, raincoat, backpack or shoes in bed. Scene continuity: 卧室；夜间，木床、木窗、暖黄毛毯、星星睡帽和单个胡萝卜玩偶位置固定
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 温暖木床和枕头托住蜷躺的皮皮，黄毯自然铺开，氛围安稳；画面无字、无额外角色。
Do not add a carrot toy or any unmentioned toy; only pillow and yellow blanket are story props.
Mandatory pose/prop state (overrides neutral model-sheet poses): 竖屏9:16，水彩细纸纹；准确保持登记角色身份和服装；每镜表情、目光、耳姿和姿势贴合当前台词，动作自然；重要内容放在上方68%，底部32%留给字幕；禁止文字、水印、拼贴和多余角色。 卧室仅出现剧本支持的木床、柔软枕头和暖黄色毛毯；不要添加胡萝卜玩偶或其他玩具。
Style: hand-painted gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, muted natural hues, soft edges and rounded shapes, quiet storybook mood, no glossy 3D or photorealism. Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events.
